units.source_text: 她是说丙午年出生的事。

en.t: She was talking about being born in the year of Hinoeuma.

units.source_text: 回想起过去的日子，如今看到了崭新的自己……

en.t: Thinking back on the days that had passed, I now saw a completely new self...

units.source_text: 丙午年生，十六岁的处女，这个古老日本的虚假传说，多刺激我啊。

en.t: Born in the year of Hinoeuma, a sixteen-year-old virgin: how deeply that false legend of old Japan stirred me.
